mapper.select: WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.server_id) r.server_id, r.overall_status FROM pmc_inspection_run r WHERE r.received_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) ORDER BY r.server_id, r.received_at DESC ), items AS ( SELECT r.server_id, sum(CASE WHEN ri.status='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c7, sum(CASE WHEN ri.status='WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS w7, sum(CASE WHEN ri.category='SVC' AND ri.item_code='SVC_URL_STATUS' AND ri.status IN ('WARN','CRITICAL','ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS svc_fail FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id = ri.run_id WHERE r.received_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) GROUP BY r.server_id ), ag AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id) server_id, status, last_heartbeat, last_run_at FROM pmc_agent ORDER BY server_id, last_heartbeat DESC NULLS LAST ) SELECT s.server_id AS "serverId", s.hostname AS "hostname", s.service_name AS "serviceName", COALESCE(l.overall_status, 'NA') AS "lastOverall", COALESCE(i.c7, 0) AS "c7", COALESCE(i.w7, 0) AS "w7", COALESCE(i.svc_fail, 0) AS "svcFail7", COALESCE(ag.status, '-') AS "agentStatus", CASE WHEN ag.status='ACTIVE' AND (ag.last_heartbeat IS NULL OR ag.last_heartbeat < now() - interval '24 hour') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "hbStale", CASE WHEN ag.last_run_at IS NULL OR ag.last_run_at < now() - interval '7 day' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "noRun7" FROM pmc_server s LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.server_id = s.server_id LEFT JOIN items i ON i.server_id = s.server_id LEFT JOIN ag ON ag.server_id = s.server_id WHERE s.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY s.hostname
